title: SDKs, Serialization and Streaming Data

header.html: Develop code that interacts with AWS services by using APIs and SDKs (1.1.5); manage streaming data by using AWS services (1.1.6); serialize and deserialize data to integrate application code with AWS services (1.1.7)
the official AWS Developer Associate (DVA-C03) exam guide, Task 1.1

toc.title: APIs, the CLI and the SDKs

html:
1APIs, the CLI and the SDKs

Every AWS service is an HTTPS API. You reach it through the AWS SDKs (Python, JavaScript, Java and more), the AWS CLI, or CloudShell. Requests are signed with Signature Version 4; the SDK does this for you.

Concern What to know
Credentials The SDK looks through a credential provider chain: environment variables, shared credentials and config files, then role credentials from the container, instance or Lambda execution role
Region Set the Region in code, config or environment; most calls fail or hit the wrong place without it
Retries SDKs retry throttling and transient errors with backoff; you can set the retry mode and maximum attempts
Pagination List calls return pages; follow the next token (or use the SDK paginator)
Waiters Poll until a resource reaches a state (for example, an instance is running)
Timeouts Set connect and read timeouts for resilient code

Exam tip

. Code running on AWS should use a role, not access keys in code. The SDK picks the role up from the credential chain automatically.

2Serialization and deserialization

Serialization turns an in-memory object into bytes or text to send or store; deserialization reverses it.

Format or task Where it appears
JSON API Gateway, Lambda events, SQS and SNS message bodies
Base64 Binary data inside JSON (API Gateway binary payloads, some Lambda event bodies)
DynamoDB attribute values The low-level API uses typed values such as {"S": "text"} and {"N": "42"}; document or resource clients marshal native types for you
Avro, Protobuf, Parquet Streaming and analytics formats

Always validate and handle bad input when you deserialize, and watch character encoding (UTF-8).

3Streaming data

Service What it does
Amazon Kinesis Data Streams Real-time stream you read yourself; shards give capacity; a partition key decides the shard
Amazon Data Firehose Loads streams into S3, OpenSearch and other destinations with buffering; optional Lambda transformation; no shards to manage
DynamoDB Streams Change records of table writes, read by Lambda

Kinesis Data Streams essentials

Topic Fact
Shard capacity About 1 MB/s or 1,000 records/s in, 2 MB/s out per shard [Verify live]
Partition key Same key goes to the same shard, preserving order per key; a hot key overloads one shard
Too fast ProvisionedThroughputExceededException means add shards, spread keys, or retry with backoff
Consumers Lambda event source mapping, the Kinesis Client Library, or enhanced fan-out for dedicated throughput per consumer
Retention 24 hours by default, extendable (up to 365 days) [Verify live]
Exam tip

. Need custom real-time processing and replay = Kinesis Data Streams. Need to land data in S3 with minimal code = Firehose.

Exam tip

. A hot Kinesis partition key overloads one shard. Spread keys or add shards, and retry with backoff on ProvisionedThroughputExceededException.

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1An application running on EC2 must call DynamoDB. What is the best way to provide credentials?

  • AAttach an IAM role to the instance and let the SDK find it
  • BPut long-term access keys in the application's source code and rotate them yearly
  • CStore access keys in a public bucket that the instance reads at startup
  • DShare one IAM user's keys across all servers in the account
Show the answer

Answer: A. The SDK credential chain uses role credentials from the instance automatically.

S2A list call returns only the first 100 items. What should the code do?

  • AFollow the next token or use a paginator
  • BIgnore the remaining items because the first page is enough
  • CCall the API once more with the same request and hope for different results
  • DIncrease the Region setting of the client so it returns more items
Show the answer

Answer: A. List APIs return pages; follow the next token.

S3Producers write many records with the same partition key and one shard is overloaded. What is the likely cause?

  • AToo many consumers
  • BA hot partition key
  • CData Firehose buffering
  • DA missing Region
Show the answer

Answer: B. The same key always maps to the same shard.

S4A team wants to deliver streaming clickstream data to S3 with minimal code and no shard management. Which service fits?

  • AAmazon SQS
  • BAWS Step Functions
  • CAmazon Data Firehose
  • DAmazon EventBridge
Show the answer

Answer: C. Firehose loads streams into destinations with buffering and no shards to manage.

S5Binary image data must travel inside a JSON body. What is the usual encoding?

  • ABase64
  • BYAML
  • CCSV
  • DHTML
Show the answer

Answer: A. Base64 encodes binary data as text for JSON.

S6A consumer needs dedicated read throughput that does not compete with other consumers of the same stream. What should be used?

  • AEnhanced fan-out
  • BA larger visibility timeout
  • CA dead-letter queue
  • DA bigger shard key
Show the answer

Answer: A. Enhanced fan-out gives each consumer its own throughput.

4.2 Recall questions

R1What signs AWS API requests?

Show the answer

Signature Version 4, applied by the SDK.

R2Where does the SDK find role credentials?

Show the answer

In the credential provider chain (container, instance or Lambda role).

R3What decides which Kinesis shard gets a record?

Show the answer

The partition key.

R4What is the default Kinesis retention?

Show the answer

24 hours.

R5What does Firehose do?

Show the answer

Buffers and delivers streaming data to destinations such as S3 and OpenSearch.

R6What is serialization?

Show the answer

Turning an in-memory object into bytes or text to send or store.

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
SDK credential chain (use roles), Region, retries, pagination, waiters
Serialization JSON, base64, DynamoDB typed values
Kinesis Data Streams shards, partition key, 24 h retention, enhanced fan-out
Firehose managed delivery to S3 and others, buffering, no shards
